cite_runs: Shaolei Ren is a professor of electrical and computer engineering who studies A.I. and society at the University of California, Riverside, and led the analysis used by the Environmental Protection Network. He said because of the Trump administration’s explicit focus on increasing the use of fossil fuels, “the actual impact could be worse than we modeled.”
body: To protect public health, he said, there also needed to be a focus beyond tech companies’ emissions of planet-warming greenhouse gases, to air pollution that harms local communities.
